title: How to register a Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) with CAC
summary: Register a Nigerian Limited Liability Partnership through CAC's official CRP, including the two-partner minimum, designated-partner rules, partnership agreement and 12-working-hour service target for a complete application.
feeNote: CAC fees can change and may depend on the filing. Confirm the amount calculated by the official CRP before payment.
timeline: CAC's revised service timeline lists 12 working hours for LLP registration after complete documents and any query are resolved.
requirements: At least two partners and at least two designated partners, with at least one designated partner resident in Nigeria
Designated partners must be individuals aged 18 or older and must consent on the registration application
Recognised photo identification for individual partners, plus NIMC identity or residence-permit evidence where CAC requires it for a foreign partner resident in Nigeria
A partnership agreement matching the approved LLP name and partner particulars
A reserved/approved name and any reservation code required for restricted words
steps: Create or sign in to the official CAC CRP account and complete the name-availability/reservation process for the proposed LLP.
Start a new LLP registration and enter the partnership, registered-office, business-object and partner details exactly as they will appear in the supporting documents.
Add the designated partners and confirm that at least one designated partner is resident in Nigeria and that every designated partner is at least 18.
Upload the partnership agreement and identity/supporting documents required for the listed partners, then review names, signatures and addresses for consistency.
Pay the filing amount shown by CAC, submit the application and monitor the CRP dashboard for approval or a query; respond to any query through the official portal.
notes: CAC's checklist states that an LLP must have at least two partners and two designated partners, one of whom must be resident in Nigeria.
A corporate body may be an LLP partner, but a designated partner must be an individual; CAC also requires the partnership agreement to match the approved name and partner particulars.

title: How to register a Limited Partnership (LP) with CAC
summary: Register a Nigerian Limited Partnership through CAC's CRP, including the general/limited partner structure, partner limits, partnership agreement and CAC's 12-working-hour service target.
feeNote: Use the amount generated by CAC's official CRP because filing charges can change.
timeline: CAC's revised service timeline lists 12 working hours for Limited Partnership registration after complete documents and any query are resolved.
requirements: At least one general partner and at least one limited partner; CAC states the partnership must not exceed 20 partners
General partners must be individuals
Recognised photo identification for individual partners
A partnership agreement stating the partnership terms and matching the approved LP name
A reserved/approved LP name and any reservation code required for restricted words
steps: Sign in to the CAC CRP and complete name availability/reservation for the proposed Limited Partnership.
Start the LP registration and enter the principal place of business, business objects and full partner particulars without initials.
Identify at least one general partner and one limited partner and ensure the partnership remains within CAC's partner limit.
Upload the partnership agreement and identity/supporting documents required by CAC, making sure the uploaded information matches the CRP data.
Pay the official filing amount shown in the portal, submit the application and monitor the CRP dashboard for approval or a query.
notes: CAC's checklist says foreigners cannot carry on or join in carrying on business under a Limited Partnership.
CAC states a Limited Partnership must have at least one general and one limited partner and no more than 20 partners.

timeline: CAC's checklist says the notice should be filed within 14 days of the resolution.

The new traceable registered-office or head-office address
A completed online CAC filing for the address change
steps: Sign in to CAC's CRP and open the registered LLP record.
Choose the LLP post-incorporation filing for change of registered office or head-office address.
Enter the new address exactly and review it for sufficient traceable detail.
Complete the online filing, pay the amount generated by CAC and submit the notice.
Monitor the CRP dashboard for approval or any query and retain the updated filing record.

title: How to change LLP partners or partner details with CAC
summary: CAC uses separate forms for three LLP partner changes: CAC/LLP 04 for an existing partner's particulars, CAC/LLP 05 for admission, and CAC/LLP 06 for cessation. Its checklist calls for notice within 30 days of the change; do not confuse the forms.
feeNote: Use the current amount generated by CAC's CRP.
timeline: CAC says notice of a change in LLP partners or their particulars should be filed within 30 days of the change.
requirements: Identify whether an existing LLP partner's details are changing, a new individual or corporate partner is joining, or a current partner is ceasing.
Use the matching CAC/LLP 04, CAC/LLP 05 or CAC/LLP 06 form, with the LLP registration details and effective date.
Provide the recognised photo ID and any NIMC identity or residence-permit evidence required for the affected individual; CAC bars people under 18 from being designated partners.
Arrange authentication by a designated partner of the LLP, as shown on the applicable form.
steps: Open the registered LLP in CAC's official iCRP and identify the exact partner transaction before selecting a post-registration form.
For correcting an existing partner's name, contact or address particulars, choose CAC/LLP 04. For admitting a new partner choose CAC/LLP 05; for cessation choose CAC/LLP 06.
Complete the relevant partner or corporate-body details and effective date; supply a recognised photo ID or the additional NIMC/residence evidence where applicable.
Have a designated partner authenticate the notice, review the portal-generated fee and submit through the official filing route.
CAC's operations checklist says to notify the Commission within 30 days of the partner change. Check the status/queries in iCRP and retain the approved record.
notes: Three distinct forms: CAC/LLP 04 changes existing-partner particulars; CAC/LLP 05 admits a partner; CAC/LLP 06 records cessation. CAC's checklist groups these under 'Change in partners or their particulars', but that does not make the forms interchangeable.

CAC/LLP 06 notes that, absent an agreement on cessation, a departing partner must give other partners at least 30 days' written notice of intended resignation. That internal notice is distinct from CAC's 30-day filing window.

title: How to change a Limited Partnership principal place of business with CAC
summary: CAC/LP 02 covers a change of a Limited Partnership's principal place of business, a branch-address change, or notice of a new branch. The form distinguishes these choices; CAC's operations checklist says to file a principal-place change within seven days.
feeNote: Confirm the current amount in CAC's CRP.
timeline: CAC says notice of an LP principal-place-of-business change should be filed within seven days of the change.
requirements: LP registration number, exact legal partnership name and effective date of the address change.
New street, locality, local-government area and state for the principal address or the affected branch, plus postal code where available.
Authorisation from a general partner: the CAC/LP 02 form is signed by a general partner, not automatically by any unrelated applicant.
steps: Open the registered LP record in CAC's iCRP and choose the LP address-change transaction (CAC/LP 02).
Select whether you are changing the principal place of business, changing a branch address, or notifying a new branch. Do not use the LLP registered-office form for an LP.
Enter the effective date and complete the relevant principal-place or branch fields; CAC's form identifies building number, street, town, local government and state.
Have a general partner authorise the filing, confirm the portal-generated fee and submit the online notice.
For a principal-place-of-business change, CAC's checklist states a seven-day filing window. Track the CRP acknowledgement and approved record.
notes: CAC/LP 02 is the LP principal-place or branch-address form and requires a general partner's authentication; it is distinct from CAC/LLP 02, which changes an LLP's registered or head-office address.

The seven-day deadline in CAC's 2022 checklist expressly applies to changing the principal place of business. Confirm any branch-specific timing in the official filing route instead of assuming it is identical.

title: How to change Limited Partnership partners or their details with CAC
summary: CAC's LP operations checklist groups partner changes and corrections under Form CAC/LP 05, but CAC's actual LP 05 form expressly excludes adding or removing a partner. Identify which change you need before filing; the wrong form may not be accepted.
feeNote: Use the current fee generated in CAC's official CRP.
timeline: CAC says notice of a change in LP partners or their particulars should be filed within seven days of the change.
requirements: LP registration number, current partnership record and date of the proposed change.
For a correction to an existing partner's particulars, the completed CAC/LP 05 notice and a recognised photo ID as required by CAC's operations checklist.
For adding or removing a partner, confirm the current transaction route directly in CAC's iCRP or with its helpdesk; CAC/LP 05 says it is not for this purpose.
steps: Open the registered Limited Partnership record in CAC's official iCRP, then identify whether you need to correct existing partner particulars or actually add/remove a partner; these require different transactions.
For a correction, open the relevant LP record in CAC's iCRP and use the particulars-change filing described by CAC/LP 05.

Do not select CAC/LP 05 for adding or removing a partner. CAC's regulations exclude those changes from this form even though its operational checklist groups them together; verify the correct route first.
Complete the selected authorised online notice, attach the recognised photo identification when required, and review the information and generated fee.
CAC's operational checklist says partner-change notices should be filed within seven days of the change. Confirm the applicable procedure with the issuer and retain the acknowledgement.
notes: CAC/LP 05 permits changes or corrections to an existing partner's particulars, such as name, contact or residential address. The form expressly says it cannot be used to add or remove a partner.

CAC's 2022 operations checklist calls the combined category 'Change in partners or their particulars' and states a seven-day filing window. This broader heading does not override the actual form's stated exclusions.
